english: Yellowing leaf tips in maize usually mean the crop is starving for nitrogen, an essential nutrient for leafy growth. Adding manure, compost, or a nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps restore the green color and boost grain development.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa nɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ he miihia nitrogen. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa kɛha baai lɛ adalɛ Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii, ŋmɔshi nibii, loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen eyi mli obɔ fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ekɛ ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aku sɛɛ aba ni eha dumɔwui lɛ aya hiɛ.

english: How does planting groundnuts on my farmland help improve the soil for next season?
ga: Te ŋmeii ni aduɔ yɛ miŋmɔshi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baanyɛ aha shikpɔŋ lɛ aya hiɛ aha be ni baa lɛ aha tɛŋŋ?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that pull nitrogen gas from the air and store it in tiny nodules on their roots. When the plant roots decompose, that captured nitrogen stays in the dirt as natural food for future crops.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni gbalaa nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛtoɔ ŋmeii bibii amli yɛ shishifãi lɛ anɔ. Nitrogen ni anáa lɛ hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli akɛ adebɔɔ mli niyenii kɛha wɔsɛɛ tsei.

english: How does covering the ground around my crop stems with dry bush grass help my plants?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ jwɛi ni egbi ni mikɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ ni bɔle mi tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ yeɔ ebuaa mi tsei lɛ?

english: Covering the ground with dry grass or leaves, called mulching, acts like a blanket that stops soil moisture from evaporating, keeps plant roots cool in hot weather, and prevents weeds from taking over.
ga: Atsɛɔ jwɛi loo baai ni egbi ni akɛhaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ mulching. Etsuɔ nii tamɔ tsɔne ni tsiɔ nu ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ naa koni ekaho. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni tso shishifãi lɛ feɔ fɛ̃i yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ mli. ni etsĩ jwɛi lɛ anaa koni ekaye nɔ.

english: Why do I need to cut wooden poles to support my yam vines as they grow?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafo tsei ni akɛfiɔ mi-sweet potato wain tsei lɛ asɛɛ be mli ni amɛdaraa lɛ?

english: Yam vines need to climb high on poles to spread their leaves fully into the sunlight. Maximum sun exposure allows the leaves to make more food, which feeds the underground tuber and makes it grow larger.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ akwɔ tso kakadaŋŋ ko nɔ koni amɛbaji lɛ aje kpo yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ nɔ. Hulu la ni tsoɔ babaoo lɛ haa baai lɛ woɔ niyenii babaoo. ni yeɔ shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ ni ehaa baai lɛ daraa lɛ.

english: Why shouldn't I let all the tiny shoots grow around the base of my main plantain stem?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miŋmɛɔ gbɛ ni ŋmeii bibii shwereɔ yɛ midumɔwui titrii lɛ ashishi lɛ he lɛ?

english: If you leave too many suckers growing together, they will steal water and nutrients from the main plant. Trimming away extra suckers leaves only the strongest shoot, ensuring larger and heavier plantain bunches.
ga: Kɛji oŋmɛ gbɛ ni ŋmeii babaoo kwɛ̃ yɛ he kome lɛ, Amɛjuɔ nu kɛ niyenii kɛjɛɔ tsei ni hereɔ amɛ lɛ amli. Kɛ́ ofolɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine lɛ, ŋmeii ni he wa fe fɛɛ lɛ pɛ baashi. Enɛ baaha plantain tsei lɛ afee wuji ni amɛtsii.

english: Those holes are caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars that burrow inside the central leaf funnel of maize. Spraying recommended treatments like bio-pesticides or neem leaf extract early in the morning kills the caterpillars before they ruin the plant heart.
ga: Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni shwieɔ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ ŋmãa baai lɛ ateŋ lɛ amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ buji lɛ baa. Kɛ́ okɛ tsofa ni akɛgbeɔ kooloi ni awieɔ he tamɔ tsofa ni gbeɔ kooloi loo neem tso lɛ mli nu lɛ shwie nɔ leebi lɛ, ebaagbe kooloi lɛ dani amɛfite tso lɛ tsui lɛ.

english: Why are the leaves of my tomato plants curling up tightly during dry hot weather?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ be mli ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ ni hulu lɛ enyɔ shi lɛ?

english: Leaf curling in tomatoes is often caused by a virus spread by tiny whitefly insects that multiply in hot weather. Controlling whiteflies early using soapy water sprays or insect netting stops the virus from spreading.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, hela ko ni ŋmeii bibii ni ji whiteflies lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ shi. ni fɔɔ yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ mli Early Whitefly Control Kɛ akɛ nu ni akɛ samla shwieɔ nɔ loo kooloi ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaakpa hela lɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ.

english: Heavy rains cause high humidity, creating the ideal environment for a fungus that causes Black Pod disease. Pruning tree branches to open the canopy lets sunlight and air pass through, drying out the pods and preventing fungus spread.
ga: Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ kɛ hulutsoo babaoo baa. Ehaa shihilɛ ni hi jogbaŋŋ kɛhaa ŋmei ni kɛ blackpod hela baa lɛ. Niji ni afoɔ lɛ gbeleɔ ŋwɛitsu lɛ naa koni hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ atsɔ mli. Enɛ haa ŋmeii lɛ mli egbiɔ ni ehaa ŋmeii lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa.

english: How come my cassava crop can still survive even after months without rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava lɛ baanyɛ ahi shi kɛji nugbɔ enɛɛɛ nyɔji babaoo po lɛ?

english: Cassava survives long droughts by shedding its leaves to stop losing water, going into a dormant state while drawing on energy stored deep inside its underground root tubers until the rains return.
ga: Cassava hiɔ shi yɛ hɔmɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ mli kɛtsɔ ebaa ni eshwieɔ shi koni ekɛkpa nu ni elaajeɔ lɛ nɔ. ni ebote shihilɛ ni yɔɔ kpoo mli ni egbala hewalɛ ni ato yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi shishifãi lɛ amli shɔŋŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi nugbɔ lɛ baaku esɛɛ aba.

english: Yellowing on the lower leaves of maize usually means the plant lacks nitrogen, a key nutrient it needs to grow strong. The plant moves nitrogen from old bottom leaves to feed new top leaves, showing that the soil needs fertilizer or well-rotted manure.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmãa ni shishigbɛ baai lɛ ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa ni he hiaa kɛha dalɛ ni hi jogbaŋŋ Tsei jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ baai momoi amli koni ekɛha ŋwɛi baa heei lɛ niyenii. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he miihia ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ.

english: Maize takes a lot of food out of the soil, but legumes like groundnuts and cowpeas put nitrogen back into the dirt through their roots. Planting them after maize naturally refreshes your land for future crops.
ga: Abele heɔ eniyenii babaoo kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Shi ŋmeii tamɔ ŋmeii kɛ tsina ŋmeii kɛ nitrogen kuɔ sɛɛ kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ. Abele ni ooodu yɛ abele sɛɛ lɛ baaha okpokpaa lɛ nɔ aná hewalɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa kɛha wɔsɛɛ dumɔ.

english: Why do some of my cassava stem cuttings sprout quickly while others die in the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tsei lɛ ekomɛi daa oya ni ekrokomɛi hu gboiɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava stems need to be cut from healthy, mature plants and buried right-side up, with the buds pointing toward the sky. If you plant them upside down or use soft young stem tops, they will fail to root and die.
ga: Esa akɛ afo ŋmei tso lɛ kɛjɛ tso ni yɔɔ hewalɛ, ni edara mli ni afu lɛ hiɛ kɛya ŋwɛi. ni fɔfɔii lɛ ashishifãi lɛ tsɔɔ ŋwɛi Kɛji okɛ amɛ shwie shi loo okɛ ŋmeii bibii tsu nii lɛ, Amɛshishifãi baagboi.

english: How do I choose the right plantain suckers to plant in my farm?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mahala plantain tsei ni sa ni mikɛdu yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli?

english: Look for 'sword suckers'—these are young shoots with narrow, spear-like leaves and thick bases. Avoid shoots with broad, flat leaves because they produce weak plants with smaller plantain bunches.
ga: Taomɔ ‘klante ŋmeii’, ni ji ŋmeii bibii ni baai ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni tamɔ akpɔlɔ kɛ shishi ni mli tse. Tsi ohe kɛjɛ ŋmeii ni baai lɛ mli kwɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ ahe ejaakɛ enɛ baaha tso lɛ afee gbɔjɔmɔ ni ehiɛ plantain tsei bibii.

english: Why should I wait for the major rains to settle before sowing my seeds?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mamɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa dani madu dumɔwui lɛ?

english: Seeds need constant moisture to germinate and build strong roots. Planting after just one early shower can trap seeds in dry ground if the rain stops for days, causing them to dry up and die.
ga: Dumɔwui taoɔ nu daa koni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛfee shishifãi ni wa. Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ leebi nugbɔ kome pɛ sɛɛ lɛ baanyɛ amɔmɔ dumɔwui yɛ hei ni nugbɔ lɛ ekpa kɛji nugbɔ lɛ kpa gbii babaoo. Enɛ baaha dumɔwui lɛ agbi ni amɛgboi.

english: Curled leaves on pepper plants are typically caused by tiny insects like aphids or thrips sucking leaf juices, or by a virus carried by these insects. Spraying early with neem water or insecticidal soap helps protect new leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, koolooi bibii, tamɔ aphids loo thrips, ni miinu baa nu lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni ekpɔtɔ yɛ pepper tsei anɔ lɛ baa. aloo kɛjɛ helai ni nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ kɛbaa lɛ amli Kɛ akɛ neem nu loo samla ni gbeɔ kooloi lɛ shwie nɔ mra Ebaaye ebua ni ebu baai heei lɛ ahe.

english: Why are the flowers on my cocoa trees dropping off instead of turning into pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ mi cacao tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miiho yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni amɛbaafee ŋmeii lɛ?

english: Cocoa flowers often drop when the tree is stressed by dry winds, lack of shade, or tiny insect pests like mirids. Maintaining shade trees and keeping soil moist helps flowers stay attached and form healthy pods.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kookoo fɔfɔi lɛ gbeeɔ shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli egbi tswa tso lɛ, ebɛ hulutsoo, loo eyɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai bibii tamɔ pollen. Kɛ́ tso lɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ he ni amɛfeɔ ŋmeii ni wa.

english: Why do the bottom ends of my green tomatoes turn black and soft?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato ŋmɔji lɛ ashishifãi lɛ miitsɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛmiifee blɛoo lɛ?

english: This black spot is called blossom-end rot, caused by inconsistent watering or a lack of calcium in the plant. Keeping soil moisture steady throughout fruiting prevents this damage.
ga: Atsɛɔ nɛkɛ he diŋ nɛɛ akɛ fɔfɔii anaagbee fitemɔ. Nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa ji nu ni afɔɔ lɛ daa loo calcium ni bɛ tso lɛ mli. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni aaakwɛ nɔ be fɛɛ be yɛ yibiiwoo be fɛɛ mli lɛ baaye abua ni atsĩ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ naa.

english: Why do my crops grow slowly when weeds are left around them for too long?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ daa fiofio kɛ́ ashi jwɛi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ lɛ?

english: Weeds are fast growers that steal water, fertilizer, and sunlight away from your crops. Clearing weeds within the first few weeks gives your crops full access to the soil's nutrients.
ga: Jwɛi ji tsei ni kwɛ̃ɔ oya ni juɔ nu, ŋmɔshi nibii, kɛ hulu la kɛjɛɔ onibii amli. Kɛ́ ogbe jwɛi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ otsii fioo lɛ amli lɛ, ebaaha otsei lɛ aná niyenii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ.

english: Why do I need to clear tall bushes and put stakes up for my yam vines to climb?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafo tsei ni kwɔlɔ lɛ amli ni mikɛ tsei awo sweet potato wain tsei lɛ anɔ koni amɛkwɔ lɛ?

english: Yam vines need sunlight to make food that builds big tubers under the ground. Staking lifts the leaves off the shade of the ground so they catch direct sunlight, leading to much larger harvests.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la koni amɛkwɛ̃ bulbs wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi. Staking jieɔ baai lɛ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi koni hulu la lɛ ashɛ amɛhe tɛ̃ɛ. Enɛ kɛ nikpamɔ babaoo baa.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings keep dying when I plant them in an open field without any trees around?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo tsei bibii lɛ gboiɔ be fɛɛ be kɛ́ midu amɛ yɛ ŋmɔ ko ni tsei bɛ he lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants cannot handle direct, intense sunlight because their leaves are soft and dry out quickly. They need shade crops like plantains planted alongside them to act as natural umbrellas, keeping them cool and moist during their first few years.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ nyɛŋ akpee hulu la tɛ̃ɛ. Akɛni baai lɛ ji bibii ni amɛgbiɔ oya hewɔ lɛ Amɛhe miihia tsei ni haa hulutsoo, tamɔ tsei bibii ni adu yɛ amɛmasɛi. Koni etsu nii akɛ adebɔɔ mli ŋwɛi ŋta Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa amɛhe jɔɔ ni amɛnáa nu yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Why are the flowers on my cashew trees falling off before turning into nuts?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ cashew tsei anɔ lɛ shwieɔ shi dani amɛfeɔ ŋmeii lɛ?

english: Cashew flowers drop prematurely mainly due to insect attacks or prolonged dry spells during the flowering period. Spraying recommended pest controls early in the season and keeping the ground around the tree free of weeds helps flowers set into nuts.
ga: Cashew fɔfɔii lɛ gbeeɔ shi oya, titri lɛ yɛ kooloi ni tutuaa amɛ loo be kakadaŋŋ ni hulu lɛ enyɔ shi yɛ fɔfɔii lɛ amli lɛ hewɔ. Akɛ tsofai ni gbeɔ kooloi lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ be lɛ shishijee mli ni asaa he ni ebɔle he lɛ. Kɛ́ jwɛi bɛ tso lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaye ebua fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛfee ŋmeii.

english: How long does a new oil palm seedling usually take before it starts bearing fruit?
ga: Bei pii lɛ, be enyiɛ eheɔ dani ŋmei dumɔwui heei jeɔ yibiiwoo shishi?

english: Improved oil palm varieties typically start producing their first small fruit bunches around 3 to 4 years after planting, as long as they receive adequate sunlight, water, and regular weed clearing.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, mu tsei srɔtoi ni afee amɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ jeɔ shishi amɛwoɔ yibii bibii. Klɛŋklɛŋ be lɛ ji aaafee afii 3 kɛyashi 4 sɛɛ beni adu lɛ, kɛji akɛ enine shɛ hulu la, nu, kɛ jwɛi ni fa bɔ ni sa nɔ.

english: Why are the leaves on my coconut trees turning bright yellow and dropping off early?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmeii tsei anɔ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛshwieɔ shi oya lɛ?

english: Yellowing coconut leaves are usually caused by a lack of nutrients like potassium in the soil or by diseases such as Lethal Yellowing. Adding suitable fertilizers and using disease-resistant seedling varieties helps keep the palms green and productive.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, niyenii mli hewalɛ ni bɛ, tamɔ potassium ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ, loo hela, tamɔ hela ko ni haa baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ ŋmei baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ. Nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli jogbaŋŋ kɛ dumɔwui srɔtoi ni helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa ŋmei tsei lɛ feɔ eŋɔli ni amɛwoɔ yibii.

english: Cassava roots rot when water collects around them in heavy, poorly drained soils. Planting cassava stems on raised mounds or ridges allows excess rainwater to drain away, keeping the tubers dry and healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi fiteɔ kɛji nu bua ehe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni tsii ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ. Kasava tsei ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkei lɛ anɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa. Ehaa ŋmeii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni amɛnáa hewalɛ.

english: Yam vines need to spread their leaves high in the sun to gather energy to grow large tubers under the ground. Lifting the vines off the dirt also stops wet soil diseases from damaging the leaves.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ agbɛ amɛbaai lɛ ashwã hulu lɛ mli shɔŋŋ koni amɛbua hewalɛ naa koni amɛkwɛ̃ ŋmeii wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi. Wein tso lɛ ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu yeɔ ebuaa ni helai ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni efɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ akafite tso lɛ baai lɛ.

english: Yellow lower leaves mean the maize plant has run out of nitrogen, which is the main food it uses to stay green and grow strong. Applying nitrogen-based fertilizer or well-rotted manure fixes this issue.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen ni ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa lɛ koni ehi shi eŋɔli ni eda jogbaŋŋ lɛ miiho. Nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ baaye abua ni atsu naagba nɛɛ he nii.

english: Why are the leaves of my tomato plants curling upward and becoming stiff?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato baai lɛ miihoso ni amɛmiifee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ?

english: Tomato leaves curl when the plant is stressed by hot weather, lack of water, or tiny insects like whiteflies spreading viruses. Providing light shade, regular watering, and spraying for insects prevents this.
ga: Tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ, nu ni bɛ, loo kooloi bibii tamɔ ŋmeii ni gbɛɔ helai ni baa mɔ mli lɛ ha tso lɛ hao. Ni akɛ hulutsoo be ko baaha Nu daa Kɛ kooloi ni akɛshwieɔ nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni atsĩ naagba nɛɛ naa.

english: Pepper plants drop flowers when they get too hot or dry out between waterings. Keeping the soil cool with mulch and watering regularly during hot weather helps the plant hold onto its flowers so peppers can form.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baajie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ kɛji edɔ tsɔ loo egbi yɛ nu ni akɛhaa lɛ teŋ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ mli fɛ̃i, ni awo lɛ nu daa yɛ be mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ehiɛɔ fɔfɔi lɛ amli bɔni afee ni ŋmeii lɛ anyɛ afee.

english: Why should I cut away some of the extra shoots growing around my plantain tree?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ ehe lɛ ekomɛi? Mi plantain lɛ baai lɛ

english: If too many young shoots grow around one plantain stem, they steal food, water, and sunlight from each other, resulting in tiny bunches. Cutting away extra shoots leaves only two or three strong stems that produce large, heavy plantains.
ga: Kɛji ŋmeii bibii babaoo ni miida yɛ Plantain kome he lɛ Amɛjuɔ niyenii, nu, kɛ hulu la kɛjɛɔ amɛhe. ni kɛ tso bibioo ko baa Kɛ́ afo tsei ni fa fe nine lɛ, tsei 2-3 pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ shwieɔ shi koni ekɛ plantains wuji ni tsii baa.

english: People keep talking about feeding crops, but do plants really need food other than water and sunlight?
ga: Bei pii lɛ, mɛi wieɔ tsei ni akɛyeɔ nii lɛ ahe. Shi ani niyenii kroko he miihia tsei diɛŋtsɛ fe nu kɛ hulu la?

english: Yes, just like humans need solid food to grow strong, plants need nutrients from the soil like nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Water helps them drink these nutrients, but without rich soil or fertilizer, they will stay small and produce very little harvest.
ga: Hɛɛ, taakɛ niyenii ni wa he hiaa adesai koni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ lɛ. Tsei taoɔ niyenii ni jɛɔ sũ mli, tamɔ naitrɔjin, fɔsfɔras, kɛ potasiam. Nu yeɔ ebuaa amɛ ni amɛnuɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ nɛɛ. Shi kɛji shikpɔŋ ni baa nii loo ŋmɔshi nibii bɛ lɛ Amɛbaafee bibii ni amɛbaawo yibii fioo ko pɛ.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean your crop is hungry for nitrogen, which is a key plant food. Adding fertilizer or well-rotted manure gives the plant the energy it needs to make healthy green leaves and big ears of corn.
ga: Baai ŋmɔŋ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen he miihia onibii, ni ji tso lɛ niyenii titri. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ fata he lɛ, ehaa tsei lɛ náa hewalɛ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛwo baai eŋɔli ni mli wa kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii agboi.

english: Does a crop with lots of big green leaves always mean I will get a huge harvest underground?
ga: Ani ŋmɔshi nibii ni baai agboi babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ maná ŋmaa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi be fɛɛ be?

english: Not always. If a plant gets too much nitrogen, it spends all its energy growing leaves above ground instead of food below ground. Balanced feeding ensures the plant puts its energy into growing big tubers like cassava or yam.
ga: Jeee be fɛɛ be, kɛji tso lɛ nine shɛɔ nitrogen babaoo nɔ. Tsei kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ ni jɛɔ baai ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii. Yɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ yeli najiaŋ Niyenii ni ja ni akɛhaa lɛ haa tsei kɛ amɛhewalɛ tsuɔ nii kɛduɔ shishifãi wuji tamɔ ŋmei loo ŋmei.

english: Young cocoa plants are like tender babies and cannot handle harsh, direct sunlight. They need shade from plantain trees or nurse trees to protect their leaves from burning and keep the soil moist while their roots grow deep.
ga: Kokoo tsei bibii tamɔ abifabii ni yɔɔ blɛoo ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛŋmɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ gbɛ. Amɛmiitao hulutsoo kɛjɛ dumɔwui loo tso nɔkwɛmɔ mli koni ebu baai lɛ ahe kɛjɛ shãa he, ni eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ be mli ni amɛshishifãi lɛ daraa kɛyaa shɔŋŋ lɛ.

english: Flowers drop off when the plant is stressed by extreme heat, lack of water, or a shortage of essential nutrients. Ensuring steady watering and good soil feeding helps the flowers stay attached and turn into healthy fruits.
ga: Fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛji dɔlɛ ni naa wa, nu ni bɛ, loo niyenii ni he hiaa ni bɛ lɛ ha tsei lɛ miihao. Nu ni akɛwoɔ fɔfɔi lɛ ahe daa kɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni akɛhaa lɛ baaye abua ni fɔfɔi lɛ akpɛtɛ he ni amɛtsɔ aduawai ni yɔɔ hewalɛ.

english: How does putting animal dung or compost into my farm soil help my cassava grow better?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni mikɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa mi-cassava lɛ ni ekwɛ̃ɔ jogbaŋŋ?

english: Animal manure and compost act as natural food that slowly feeds the soil and keeps it moist. It improves the soil structure so plant roots can easily spread, breathe, and soak up nutrients for a bigger harvest.
ga: Koolooi amli ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii tsuɔ nii akɛ adebɔɔ mli niyenii ni yaa hiɛ fiofio. Ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ niyenii ni ehaa efeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ fɛo bɔni afee ni tsei shishifãi lɛ anyɛ agbɛ ashwã, amɛmu, ni amɛŋɔ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛha ŋmaa babaoo.

english: Why does my land produce fewer crops each year when I plant maize on the exact same plot every season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ woɔ ŋmɔshi nibii fioo daa afi beni miduɔ ŋmɔshi nibii yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ daa afi lɛ?

english: Maize takes a lot of specific food out of the soil every season. If you keep planting it in the same place without giving the soil a break or planting beans and groundnuts to restock the nutrients, the soil becomes empty and tired.
ga: Abɛi heɔ niyenii pɔtɛɛi babaoo kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli daa be. Kɛji odu amɛ yɛ he kome ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shwieee shi loo odu ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii koni ekɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ lɛ, Shikpɔŋ lɛ baafee efolo ni egbɔjɔ.

english: Legumes like cowpeas have special roots that pull nitrogen food straight from the air and trap it in the soil. When the plant dies, that food stays in the soil to help the next crop grow strong without extra cost.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas yɛ shishifãi krɛdɛɛi ni gbalaa nitrogen nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli tɛ̃ɛ ni ekɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Kɛ́ tso lɛ gbo lɛ, nakai niyenii lɛ hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni eye ebua ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ ni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ ni awooo he nyɔmɔ kroko.

english: When is the best time for me to apply fertilizer to my crops so it doesn't go to waste?
ga: Mɛɛ be ji be ni hi fe fɛɛ ni esa akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo miŋmɔshi nibii amli koni amɛkafite?

english: Apply fertilizer when the soil is moist and the plant is actively growing, usually a few weeks after planting and again before flowering. Avoid applying it on bone-dry ground or during heavy downpours that wash the food away before the roots can drink it.
ga: Okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ ni tso lɛ miida lɛ. Bei pii lɛ, enɛ baa mli otsii 2-3 yɛ dumɔ sɛɛ kɛ ekoŋŋ dani fɔfɔii lɛ baa. Tsi ohe kɛjɛ he ni okɛbaawo shikpɔŋ ni egbi ni wu yɔɔ mli lɛ nɔ loo yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli koni ekɛfɔ niyenii lɛ he dani shishifãi lɛ anu.

english: Why do my crops look wilted even though I put dry chemical fertilizer around them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nii lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni egbo lɛ? Tsofa ni egbi ni akɛwo he fɛɛ he

english: Plants cannot eat dry fertilizer directly; they can only drink their food when it is dissolved in water. Without moisture, fertilizer sits on top of the soil or can even burn the roots, so you must always ensure the soil is moist when feeding your plants.
ga: Tsei nyɛŋ aye ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbi lɛ tɛ̃ɛ. Amɛbaanyɛ amɛnu niyenii kɛji akɛ amɛwo nu mli pɛ. Kɛji hulutsoo be bɛ lɛ, Fɛ̃i baanyɛ akpɛtɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he loo eshã shishifãi lɛ po. No hewɔ lɛ, ehe miihia ni okwɛ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔtɔ be fɛɛ be kɛ́ ooha tsei lɛ niyenii.

english: Why are my maize leaves turning yellow from the middle instead of staying deep green?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛmiijɛ teŋgbɛ yɛ ŋmɔŋ ni mli edɔ najiaŋ lɛ?

english: Yellowing leaves, especially starting from the center of the leaf, usually mean the soil lacks nitrogen. Maize plants need plenty of nitrogen to build green leaves and grow strong cobs, so adding compost or nitrogen fertilizer early in the growing stage solves this.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ titri lɛ jeɔ shishi kɛjɛɔ baa lɛ teŋgbɛ. Bei pii lɛ, enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nitrogen babaoo he miihia ŋmã tsei koni amɛwo baai eŋɔli ni amɛkwɛ̃ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he mra yɛ be mli ni edara lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni atsu naagba nɛɛ he nii.

english: Why do elderly farmers say planting cowpeas makes the soil better for the next maize crop?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okwaafonyo ko ni eda lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, kɛ́ edu tsina ŋmei lɛ, ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ ahi jogbaŋŋ kɛha ŋmãa ni ebaadu yɛ sɛɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cowpeas are legumes that work with helpful soil bacteria to pull nitrogen out of the air and fix it into the soil. When the cowpea crop is done, that trapped nitrogen stays in the soil, acting as free fertilizer for your next crop of maize.
ga: Cowpeas ji ŋmeii ni kɛ sũ mli helai ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ tsuɔ nii koni amɛgbala nitrogen kɛjɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛto sũ lɛ mli. Kɛji akɛ adu tsina ŋmei lɛ agbe naa lɛ Nitrogen ni amɔ lɛ lɛ hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Etsuɔ nii akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni damɔ shi shiŋŋ kɛha o-abele ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english: Why are there ragged holes in my young maize leaves with small green-black dirt inside the leaf funnels?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-baby corn baai lɛ yɛ bu ni egbɛ eshwa kɛ muji bibii ni ji ediŋŋ-eŋɔli lɛ? Yɛ baa lɛ mli

english: This damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm caterpillar, which hides inside the center leaf funnel and feeds on young leaves. The dirt is its waste (frass), and catching this early with proper bio-pesticides prevents the worm from destroying the growing tip of the plant.
ga: Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni kɛ amɛhe woɔ baa lɛ teŋ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ amli ni amɛyeɔ baa bibii lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Muji ji jwɛi (ashwishwɛ) ni amɔmɔ enɛ mra Kɛtsɔ tsofa ni sa ni gbeɔ kooloi ni wala yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ nɔ lɛ, atsĩɔ kooloi lɛ anaa koni amɛkafite tso lɛ yitsei lɛ.

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants curling upward and shrinking into tiny crumpled balls?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miibɔle amɛhe ni amɛmiifee bɔɔlu bibii ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ?

english: Leaf curl in pepper plants is usually caused by tiny insects like thrips, aphids, or mites sucking the sap from young shoots, or spreading a virus. Spraying with neem water or insecticidal soap helps control these tiny insects before they stunt the entire plant.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ thrips, aphids, loo mites ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ tsei bibii amli lɛ loo helai ni gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baa ni shwieɔ pepper tsei anɔ lɛ baa. Kɛ́ okɛ neem nu loo samla ni gbeɔ kooloi shwie nɔ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni eye kooloi bibii anɔ. Akɛ tsei nɛɛ shwieɔ shi dani amɛshwieɔ shi kwraa.

english: Cassava drops its leaves on purpose to reduce water loss through evaporation during dry spells. The plant goes quiet to protect the tubers underground, and it will sprout fresh leaves as soon as the rains return.
ga: Akɛ ŋmei baai shwieɔ shi koni nu ni fiteɔ kɛjɛɔ hulutsoo be mli lɛ aba shi. Tso lɛ baafee dioo koni ebu shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ ahe. Ni ebaatswa baai heei kɛji nugbɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba pɛ.

english: Yam vines naturally climb to lift their leaves up toward sunlight. Staking keeps the leaves off the damp ground where diseases spread, improves leaf air circulation, and allows maximum sunlight capture, which results in larger tubers underground.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ kwɔɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe koni amɛwo amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni amɛkɛ hulu la lɛ akpee. Staking baaha baai lɛ akashɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ ni hela lɛ baanyɛ agbɛ ashwã lɛ. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ yɛ baai lɛ amli lɛ yaa hiɛ. ni enine shɛɔ hulu la ni fe fɛɛ nɔ. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii wuji baa.

english: Why do groundnut plant blossoms bend down and push themselves into the dirt after flowering?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛtsiɔ amɛhe kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli beni amɛwo fɔfɔi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Groundnuts have a unique growth habit where they flower above ground, but once pollinated, the stem (called a peg) grows downward into the soil. The actual groundnut pod only develops and matures inside the dark, moist earth.
ga: Peanuts yɛ su krɛdɛɛ ko ni haa amɛdaraa yɛ gbɛ ni ji akɛ, amɛwoɔ fɔfɔi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ. Shi kɛ́ ashɛre ŋmɔtɔ lɛ, tso ko (ni atsɛɔ lɛ peg) kwɛ̃ɔ kɛboteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Anɔkwale ŋmei ŋmeii baanyɛ aya hiɛ ni amɛdara yɛ jeŋ ni mli ewo duŋ ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ mli pɛ.

english: Why does my main plantain tree take so long to fruit if I leave all the shoots growing around it?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ midumɔwu titri lɛ heɔ be babaoo dani ewoɔ yibii kɛji mishi ŋmeii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ ehe lɛ? Tsei lɛ fɛɛ

english: Small shoots (suckers) growing around the main plantain trunk share the same root system and steal nutrients and water from the main mother plant. Pruning away weaker shoots and keeping only one or two strong suckers helps the main tree fruit much faster and bigger.
ga: Tso bibii (tso) ni kwɛ̃ɔ ni bɔleɔ Plantain tso titri lɛ kɛ shishifã gbɛjianɔtoo kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ nii ni ejuɔ niyenii kɛ nu kɛjɛɔ fɔlɔ tso titri lɛ mli. Kɛ́ afo tsei bibii lɛ amli ni ahiɛ tso kome loo enyɔ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, ebaaye ebua tso titri lɛ ni ewo yibii oya ni efee agbo.

english: Why are the flowers on my tomato plants drying up and falling off without making any tomatoes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miigbi ni amɛmiigbee shi ni amɛwooo tomato ko kwraa lɛ?

english: Tomato blossom drop happens when weather gets extremely hot, when water supply is irregular, or when there is too much nitrogen in the soil. Keeping soil moisture consistent and shading young plants during harsh sun keeps flowers attached so fruit can form.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi ni shwieɔ shi lɛ baa kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ waa. Be mli ni nu ni jɛɔ pɔmpi mli lɛ jeee nɔ ni sa loo be mli ni nitrogen fa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni yaa nɔ daa kɛ tsei bibii ni yɔɔ hulutsoo be mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ amɛhe koni amɛwo yibii.

english: Young cocoa trees burn easily under direct, harsh sunlight during their first two years. Plantains grow fast and feature wide leaves that act as living umbrellas, giving young cocoa the shade and cool soil moisture it needs to survive.
ga: Kookoo tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ shishi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii enyɔ lɛ mli. Plantain lɛ daa oya ni eyɛ baai ni mli kwɔ ni tsuɔ nii tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋta. Ha kookoo bibii lɛ hulutsoo kɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli ejɔ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛhi shi.

english: Yellowing lower leaves usually mean the soil is low in nitrogen. Nitrogen is the key nutrient that keeps leaves green and healthy, so adding compost or nitrogen-rich fertilizer like urea helps the plant recover.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen faaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nitrogen ji niyenii titri ni haa baai lɛ feɔ eŋɔli ni amɛhe wa. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen yɔɔ mli tamɔ urea fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua tso lɛ ni ehiɛ aya hiɛ.

english: Why are my pepper plants growing tall and bushy with leaves, but not bearing any fruits?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ daa ni eyɛ ŋmɔji ni baai yɔɔ mli shi ewooo yibii lɛ?

english: This usually happens when plants receive too much nitrogen fertilizer or too much shade. The plant puts all its energy into growing leaves and height instead of producing flowers and pepper fruits.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, enɛ baa mli kɛ́ tso lɛ nine shɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo nɔ loo ahã lɛ hulutsoo babaoo. Tsei kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii kɛkwɛɔ baai kɛ amɛhe ni amɛkwɛɔ lɛ nɔ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeefee pepper fɔfɔii kɛ aduawai

english: This is caused by Black Pod Disease, a fungal infection that spreads quickly in damp, shady conditions. Pruning excess cocoa branches to let in sunlight and air, along with removing infected pods, helps stop the disease from spreading.
ga: Black pod hela lɛ kɛ enɛ baa. Enɛ ji ŋmei ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ kɛ hulutsoo yɔɔ. Kookoo niji ni fa fe nine lɛ ni afolɔ koni hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ atsɔ mli. Jiemɔ ŋmeii ni hela lɛ emɔ amɛ lɛ hu. Ebaaye ebua ni akpa helai gbɛfaŋnɔ.

english: Why do my tomato leaves curl up tightly during the daytime?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ gbi lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Tomato leaves curl to reduce water loss when exposed to hot sun, dry winds, or insect pests like whiteflies. Putting dry grass or leaves around the plant base as mulch helps keep the soil moist and cool.
ga: Tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ amɛhe koni nu ni hulu ni tsoɔ waa, kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli egbi, loo kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui tamɔ ŋmeii yɛji lɛ shwieɔ shi lɛ aba shi. Jwɛi loo baai ni egbi ni akɛwoɔ tso lɛ shishi lɛ ji ŋmɔtɔ ni haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ baa.

english: Why are the flowers on my cowpea plants falling off before forming any bean pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miiho dani pea pods lɛ baa lɛ?

english: Flower dropping is usually caused by small insect pests like thrips attacking the blossoms, or by extreme heat. Protecting the flowers from pests early on ensures they can develop into bean pods.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, tsɛŋemɔ helai bibii tamɔ thrips ni tutuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ fɔfɔii ni shwieɔ shi lɛ baa. loo kɛjɛ latsaa ni naa wa mli Mra be mli ni abuɔ fɔfɔi ahe kɛjɛɔ kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ahe Enɛ baaha fɔfɔi lɛ aya hiɛ ni amɛtsɔ ŋmeii.

english: Why are my cassava roots remaining thin and small instead of swelling up big?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ yɔɔ mlɛo ni amɛji bibii lolo yɛ agboi ni amɛfuu lɛ najiaŋ lɛ?

english: Cassava roots need loose, uncompacted soil rich in nutrients to expand. If the ground is packed hard or lacks key nutrients, the roots struggle to expand and stay small.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni mli tse, ni niyenii mli hewalɛ eyi mli obɔ lɛ he miihia cassava shishifãi koni amɛkwɛ̃. Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ loo niyenii ni he hiaa bɛ mli lɛ Shishifãi lɛ baagbɛ amɛshwã ni amɛbaafee bibii.

english: Why do my harvested yam tubers have rough bumps and deep cracks on them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potato tubers ni mikpa lɛ yɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ kɛ ŋmeii ni mli kwɔ lɛ?

english: Cracks and bumps on yams are often caused by tiny worm-like pests in the soil called nematodes, or by sudden heavy rains after a long dry spell causing the tuber to expand too fast.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii bibii ni tamɔ ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ sweet potato nɔ lɛ baa. Yɛ shikpɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ nematodes lɛ mli. Aloo kɛjɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ trukaa beni eŋɔ be kakadaŋŋ ni egbi lɛ mli. ni haa yitso lɛ mli lɛɛɔ oya tsɔ

english: Why do I need to clear weeds around my crops even if the weeds aren't touching my main plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni mafo jwɛi yɛ miŋmɔshi nibii ahe, kɛji jwɛi lɛ etaaa miŋmɔshi nibii titrii lɛ ahe po?

english: Weed roots spread broad underground and secretly drain water, plant food, and nutrients away from your crop roots long before the weeds physically touch your crops above ground.
ga: Jwɛi shishifãi gbɛɔ eshwaa shikpɔŋ shishi ni amɛjieɔ nu, tsei niyenii, kɛ niyenii mli nibii kɛjɛɔ otso lɛ shishifãi lɛ amli yɛ teemɔŋ dani jwɛi lɛ kɛ otsei ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kpeɔ.

english: Plantain plants have short, shallow root systems that struggle to support their heavy leaves and fruit bunches. Heaping soil around the base and propping up the stem with bamboo or wooden poles prevents them from falling.
ga: Dumɔwui lɛ yɛ shishifãi kukuji ni mli ekɔɔɔ ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni amɛye amɛbua baai kɛ aduawai ni tsii lɛ. Shikpɔŋ ni ooobɔle shishigbɛ lɛ he kɛ ŋmeii loo tsei ni akɛwoɔ ŋmeii lɛ anɔ lɛ baatsi amɛ gbɛ koni amɛkagbee shi.

english: Why do my vegetable seedlings look weak and limp in the afternoon even when I water them in the morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-vegetables dumɔwui lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni amɛgbɔjɔ ni amɛhe ejɔɔɔ yɛ shwane mli eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu haa amɛ leebi moŋ lɛ?

english: In hot afternoon heat, leaves lose moisture faster than roots can drink it from the soil. Deep watering early in the morning or late evening gives the roots enough time to absorb water properly.
ga: Yɛ shwane mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔɔ waa. Baai lɛ fiteɔ nu oya fe bɔ ni shishifãi baanyɛ anu kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Kɛ́ akɛ nu wo shishifãi lɛ amli jogbaŋŋ leebi loo gbɛkɛ lɛ, ehaa shishifãi lɛ náa be ni fa bɔ ni sa ni amɛkɛnuɔ nu jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do government-certified seeds often produce better harvests than the seeds I save from my previous crop?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni nɔyeli lɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ woɔ yibii kpakpai be fɛɛ be fe dumɔwui ni mikɛto kɛjɛ dumɔwui ni midu tsutsu lɛ amli lɛ?

english: Certified seeds are specially bred for high yields, uniform growth, and resistance to local pests and diseases. When you replant saved seeds from hybrid crops, those special traits break down, often resulting in weaker plants and lower yields.
ga: Akwɛɔ dumɔwui ni awo he odase lɛ yɛ gbɛ krɛdɛɛ ko nɔ koni amɛwo yibii babaoo. shweremɔ ni yɔɔ ekomefeemɔ kɛ helai kɛ kooloi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ ahewalɛ. Beni oduɔ dumɔwui ni ajie kɛjɛ tsei ni akɛfee ekome lɛ amli lɛ. Nakai sui krɛdɛɛi lɛ baafite. Bei pii lɛ, enɛ haa tsei lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni yibiiwoo lɛ baa shi.

english: How can I test if the crop seeds I received will sprout properly before I plant my whole farm?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ maka kɛji dumɔwui ni minine shɛɔ nɔ lɛ baakwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ dani madu ŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ?

english: You can do a simple germination test by placing 10 seeds in a damp cloth or wet paper towel inside a plastic bag for a few days. If 8 or more seeds sprout, your seed batch is healthy and ready for full field planting.
ga: Obaanyɛ ofee shweremɔ he kaa ko ni yɔɔ mlɛo. Obaanyɛ ofee enɛ kɛtsɔ dumɔwui 10 ni okɛaawo mama ni mli efɔ mli lɛ nɔ. Aloo wolo ni akɛfɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni okɛwo plastic kotoku mli gbii 2-3. Kɛji dumɔwui 8 loo nɔ ni fe nakai kwɛ̃ lɛ, no tsɔɔ akɛ odumɔwui akuu lɛ mli wa ni efee klalo kɛha dumɔwui fɛɛ.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean your crops are lacking nitrogen in the soil or that heavy rains washed nutrients away from the roots. Nitrogen is the main food crops use to build green leaves and grow strong stalks.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ otso lɛ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Aloo nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ haa niyenii mli hewalɛ nibii jeɔ shishifãi lɛ amli. Nitrogen ji niyenii titri ni tsei kɛtsuɔ nii koni amɛkɛfee baai eŋɔli kɛ tso lɛ shishifã ni wa.

english: In extreme heat, plants lose moisture through their leaves faster than their roots can pull it from the soil. They droop temporarily to reduce surface exposure to the sun, but they usually bounce back once the afternoon heat cools down.
ga: Yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ waa mli lɛ Tsei lɛ laajeɔ nu kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Akɛ amɛ shwieɔ shi be kukuoo ko koni hulu la lɛ akashɛ amɛhe. Shi amɛfɔɔ sɛɛkuu kɛji shwane mli latsaa lɛ mli jɔ.

english: What happens to my cassava crops if I plant the cuttings too close to each other?
ga: Mɛni baaba mi yucca tso lɛ nɔ kɛji mikɛ niji lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ?

english: When planted too close, cassava roots fight each other underground for space, water, and nutrients. Instead of growing thick, heavy tubers, the plants will produce thin, woody roots with low yield.
ga: Kɛ adu lɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ tsɔ Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni ŋmeii ni mli wa ni tsii lɛ baakwɛ̃ lɛ, ŋmeii shishifãi lɛ wuɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi koni amɛná he ko, nu kɛ niyenii. Mohu ɔ, tse ɔmɛ peeɔ sisi nyafii nɛ a woɔ yiblii tsɔ.

english: Why do my pepper crops grow tall and leafy but produce very few peppers when I plant them under big shade trees?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper lɛ daa ni ewoɔ baai shi ewoɔ pepper fioo ko pɛ kɛ́ mikɛdu tso agbo ko ni yɔɔ hulutsoo shishi lɛ?

english: Pepper plants need full sunlight to produce flowers and fruit. When growing in heavy shade, the crop spends all its energy stretching upward to find light rather than developing flowers and peppers.
ga: Pepper tsei he miihia hulu ni fa bɔni afee ni amɛwo fɔfɔi kɛ aduawai. Kɛji eda yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ Tso lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii ni ekɛshwieɔ ŋwɛi koni ena la. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeefee fɔfɔii kɛ ŋmeii

english: How does planting right at the start of the rainy season help my crops grow better than planting later?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ kɛ́ adu nii mra yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tsei lɛ ni amɛdaraa jogbaŋŋ fe ni aduɔ yɛ sɛɛ mli?

english: Early planting allows crop roots to establish while the soil is warm and rich in natural nitrogen released by the first rains. This head start helps plants grow strong enough to withstand mid-season dry spells and pest outbreaks.
ga: Dumɔ kɛjɛ gbekɛbiiashi Enɛ haa tsei shishifãi feɔ yɛ be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔɔ ni adebɔɔ mli nitrogen ni jɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ mli lɛ fa babaoo. Nɛkɛ shishijee nɛɛ yeɔ ebuaa tsei lɛ ni amɛdaraa waa bɔ ni sa ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛdamɔ hɔmɔ bei kɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai ni baa yɛ be lɛ teŋgbɛ lɛ anaa.

english: Why do my crops seem to stop growing during short dry spells in the middle of the season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ etamɔ nɔ ni miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ kpaɔ shweremɔ yɛ hɔmɔ kuku ko ni baa yɛ be lɛ teŋgbɛ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: When water becomes scarce, crops slow down their growth and close small pores on their leaves to conserve water. Once rains return or irrigation is applied, the roots absorb moisture and growth resumes.
ga: Beni nu faaa lɛ Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ baaha amɛdalɛ aya hiɛ fioo ni amɛbaaŋa buji bibii. yɛ baai anɔ koni akɛto nu he Kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ loo ekɛ nu ha tsei lɛ Shishifãi lɛ baaŋɔ nu ni amɛkwɛ̃ ekoŋŋ.

english: How does hard, compacted soil affect the way my yam tubers expand underground?
ga: Te shikpɔŋ ni wa ni mli edɔ lɛ saa bɔ ni mi-sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ shwereɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ he ehaa tɛŋŋ?

english: Hard soil acts like a physical barrier that restricts tuber development. Yam roots need loose, soft soil to expand smoothly; otherwise, they become small, crooked, or stunted.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni wa tsuɔ nii akɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ gbɛtsii nii ni tsiɔ tuber shweremɔ naa. Sweet potato shishifãi lɛ taoɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ koni egbɛ eshwa jogbaŋŋ. Kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, amɛbaafee bibii, amɛbaafee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ, loo amɛbaafee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: Why do insects attack my fresh, young seedlings much more aggressively than my older crops?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii tutuaa mi tsei bibii heei lɛ waa fe mi ŋmɔshi nibii momo lɛ?

english: Young seedlings have soft leaves that are high in water and easy for insects to chew and digest. As crops mature, their leaves become tougher and thicker, making them harder for pests to eat.
ga: Tsei bibii yɛ baai bibii ni nu babaoo yɔɔ mli. Kplukai ŋmɔɔ ni amɛyeɔ nii oya. Kɛ tsei dara lɛ Amɛbaai lɛ feɔ shiŋŋ ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Ehaa ewaa kɛhaa tsɛŋemɔ helai akɛ amɛaaye

english: Can I plant crops like maize or cassava on farmland that was previously used for galamsey?
ga: Ani manyɛ madu ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmãa loo ŋmãa yɛ ŋmɔshi shikpɔŋ ni tsutsu lɛ akɛtsuɔ nii kɛhaa galamsey lɛ nɔ?

english: Land cleared for galamsey often loses its fertile topsoil and may contain chemicals or heavy mud. Before planting food crops, the soil usually needs to be cleared of rocks, enriched with organic compost or manure, and tested to ensure it is safe and healthy for growing crops.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni ajie kɛha galamsey lɛ laajeɔ eshikpɔŋ nɔ sũ ni baa nii lɛ. ni tsofai loo sũ ni tsii baanyɛ ahi mli Dani abaadu niyenii Bei pii lɛ esa akɛ akɛ tɛi ajie sũ lɛ. Kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni wala yɔɔ mli afata he. Ni aka lɛ akwɛ koni ana akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe ni eyɛ hewalɛ kɛha tsei ni miida.

english: Why are my maize stalks staying short and yellowish even though it rains every week?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa tsei lɛ feɔ kuku ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔŋ eyɛ mli akɛ nugbɔ nɛɔ daa otsi moŋ lɛ?

english: Yellowish, stunted maize is usually a sign that the soil lacks nitrogen, an essential food for plant growth. Adding well-rotted animal manure or nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps the crop develop dark green leaves and tall, strong stalks.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmãa ni ji yellow dwarf lɛ ji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛha tsei adalɛ Kɛ́ akɛ kooloo ŋmei ni egbo jogbaŋŋ loo nitrogen ŋmei fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua tso lɛ ni ená baai ni tsuɔ tamɔ ŋmɔtɔ kɛ ŋmeii ni kɛlɛ ni wa.

english: Why shouldn't I plant my cassava stems very close together so I can harvest more on my plot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miduɔ ŋmei tsei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe koni maná ŋmaa babaoo yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: When cassava plants are crowded, their roots and leaves fight each other for sunshine, water, and soil nutrients. Proper spacing gives every stem enough room to form large, thick tubers underground instead of many small, thin ones.
ga: Kɛji akɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ eyi obɔ lɛ Eshishifãi kɛ baai lɛ wuɔ koni amɛná hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ tso lɛ he lɛ haa tso lɛ tso fɛɛ tso lɛ náa gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛfee tsei wuji ni mli tse. Yɛ yitsei bibii ni yɔɔ mlɛo babaoo najiaŋ

english: Why do my crops wilt even after I water them with muddy water from a nearby river?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni mikɛ nu ni mli ewo muji ni jɛ faa ni bɛŋkɛ jɛmɛ lɛ mli lɛ shwieɔ amɛnɔ po sɛɛ lɛ, miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ gboɔ?

english: Water heavily mixed with mud or dirt can clog plant roots and prevent them from breathing and taking up nutrients. Using clean water from rain harvesting or boreholes ensures plants can absorb moisture properly.
ga: Nu ni akɛ muji loo muji ni tsii efutu mli lɛ baanyɛ atsĩ tsei shishifãi anaa ni eha amɛkamu ni amɛkaná niyenii mli hewalɛ. Nu ni mli tse ni jɛɔ nugbɔshiimɔ loo ŋshɔkei ni afoɔ mli lɛ mli ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ haa tsei lɛ nyɛɔ amɛheɔ nu lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do the leaves of my vegetable crops burn when I water them in the middle of a hot afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kɛ́ afɔ amɛ nu yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ, aduawai tsei ahe baai lɛ shãa lɛ?

english: Water droplets on leaves act like small magnifying glasses under hot afternoon sunlight, which can scorch the leaves. It is best to water early in the morning or late in the evening so the soil absorbs the water without damaging the plants.
ga: Nu ni shwieɔ baai anɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii tamɔ glase bibii ni haa nɔ ko feɔ bibioo yɛ shwane hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Enɛ baanyɛ aha baai lɛ ashã. Esa akɛ afee nu lɛ leebi loo gbɛkɛ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ anyɛ aŋɔ nu lɛ ni efiteee tso lɛ.

english: Which fast-growing crops can I plant to feed my family while waiting for tree crops like oil palm or cocoa to yield?
ga: Mɛɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni kwɛ̃ɔ oya manyɛ madu koni mikɛha miweku lɛ niyenii yɛ be mli ni mimɛɔ ni ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ mu loo kookoo aba lɛ?

english: Short-cycle crops like cassava, maize, plantain, and leafy vegetables grow rapidly and provide food and cash income within a few months, keeping your farm productive while long-term cash crops mature.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ yɛ be kukuoo mli tamɔ ŋmãa, ŋmãa, ŋmãa kɛ aduawai ni yɔɔ baai lɛ daa oya ni amɛhaa niyenii kɛ shika baa yɛ nyɔji fioo komɛi amli. Ha oŋmɔ lɛ awo yibii yɛ be mli ni oshika ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ yaa hiɛ yɛ be kakadaŋŋ mli lɛ.

english: Why is it beneficial to plant cowpeas or beans together with my maize crop?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he akɛ mikɛ mi-ŋmãa baadu tsina loo ŋmãa lɛ?

english: Beans and cowpeas trap nitrogen gas from the air and release it into the soil through their roots. This natural plant food fertilizes the surrounding maize while the bean leaves cover the ground to prevent weeds.
ga: Beans kɛ cowpeas mɔ̃ɔ nitrogen gas ni jɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli lɛ ni amɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli amɛjieɔ kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nɛkɛ adebɔɔ mli tso niyenii nɛɛ haa ŋmãa ni ebɔle lɛ lɛ feɔ ŋmãa. yɛ be mli ni ŋmeii lɛ ahe baai lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni jwɛi akaje mli

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants curling up and turning crusty?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miihoso ni amɛmiifee ŋmɔtɔ lɛ?

english: Curling leaves are often caused by tiny insects like aphids or mites that suck the sap out of young shoots. Spraying the leaves early with soapy water or natural neem oil solutions helps control these pests before they ruin the crop.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ aphids loo mites ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ tsei bibii amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni shwieɔ shi lɛ baa. Ni ooofɔ baai lɛ anɔ mra Soap nu loo adebɔɔ mli neem mu ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ baaye abua ni akudɔ nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ dani amɛfite ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ.

english: Why does my cassava plant have lush green leaves but tiny roots when I harvest it?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tso lɛ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ shi shishifãi bibii ji nɔ ni kɛ́ mikpa lɛ lɛ?

english: When soil has too much nitrogen but lacks potassium, the plant puts all its energy into producing leaves on top instead of building tubers underground. Using balanced nutrients ensures good root development.
ga: Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nitrogen fa tsɔ shi potassium bɛ mli lɛ Tso lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii ni ekɛmaa baai yɛ nɔ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni aaafee shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ Niyenii ni sa ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ haa shishifãi lɛ yaa hiɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Yellow leaves on young maize usually mean the crop lacks nitrogen in the soil or the soil is waterlogged. Nitrogen helps plants make green foliage, so applying nitrogen-rich fertilizer like urea or improving soil drainage helps restore their green color.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa bibii anɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ bɛ nitrogen yɛ sũ lɛ mli loo akɛ nu eyi sũ lɛ mli obɔ. Nitrogen yeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛwoɔ baai eŋɔli. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ tsofai ni nitrogen eyi mli obɔ tamɔ urea tsu nii loo aha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nu hoɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni tso lɛ su lɛ afee ŋmɔŋ ekoŋŋ.

english: Young cocoa plants cannot tolerate full, direct sunlight because their roots are shallow and their leaves burn easily. Planting fast-growing shade crops like plantains nearby creates a canopy that shields the cocoa from scorching sun and keeps the soil moist.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ nyɛɛɛ aŋmɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ amɛ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ gbɛ ejaakɛ amɛshishifãi lɛ mli ekɔɔɔ ni amɛbaai lɛ shãa oya. Shade tsei ni daa oya tamɔ plantains ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ. Efeɔ ŋwɛi ŋta ni buɔ kookoo lɛ he kɛjɛɔ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ he. ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ

english: Cassava roots rot underground when soil stays soaked with too much water, preventing air from reaching the roots and allowing fungi to grow. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain away from the tubers.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi kɛ́ nu babaoo ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lolo. Enɛ haaa kɔɔyɔɔ ayashɛ shishifãi lɛ ahe ni ehaa ŋmeii lɛ shwereɔ. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ko ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛjɛɔ tsei lɛ amli.

english: What causes small worms to chew holes in the middle leaves of my maize plants?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmei feɔ bibioo nɛkɛ? Ani okɛ bu ko ni yɔɔ ŋmãa tso ko baa lɛ teŋgbɛ lɛ shwie shi?

english: These worms are Fall Armyworms, a common pest that targets the tender center leaves of maize. They hatch from eggs laid by moths and can be controlled early by hand-picking or using recommended organic or chemical sprays.
ga: Nɛkɛ ŋmeii nɛɛ ji Fall Armyworms, ni ji ŋmeii ko ni afɔɔ namɔ ni yeɔ ŋmãa baai bibii lɛ anɔ. Amɛfoɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmeii ni ŋmeii fɔɔ lɛ amli. ni abaanyɛ akudɔ kɛjɛ gbekɛbiiashi Kɛtsɔ nine ni akɛhalaa Loo ni akɛ tsofai ni akɛwoɔ mɔ mli loo tsofai ni akɛwoɔ mɔ mli ni ajieɔ yi akɛ akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do my seeds fail to grow properly if I plant them immediately after the very first rain of the year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ midumɔwui lɛ edaaa jogbaŋŋ kɛji midu amɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ yɛ afi lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ?

english: The very first rain usually only wets the surface layer of soil while the ground below remains hot and dry. If a dry spell follows, the newly germinated seeds dry out and die before the main rainy season fully begins.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, nugbɔ ni nɛɔ mra lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛ fɔ̃ɔ. yɛ be mli ni shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ mli edɔ ni edɔ lolo lɛ. Kɛji hɔmɔ ba yɛ sɛɛ mli lɛ Dumɔwui ni ekwɛ̃ ehee lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni amɛgboiɔ dani nugbɔshiimɔ be titri lɛ jeɔ shishi kwraa.

english: Pepper flowers drop off when plants face extreme heat stress, poor soil watering, or a lack of essential nutrients like phosphorus. Ensuring consistent soil moisture and using balanced fertilizer helps the flowers stay attached and form peppers.
ga: Pepper fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛji tso lɛ kɛ ehe wo hulutsoo be mli. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nu ni ehiii loo niyenii ni he hiaa, tamɔ fɔsfɔs ni bɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni ahiɔ shi daa kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni sa ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ he ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔtɔ.

english: Tomato leaf curl is caused by a plant virus carried by tiny whiteflies that suck plant sap. Managing whiteflies with insecticidal soap or physical barriers prevents the virus from spreading and stunting the crop.
ga: Tso mli hela ko ni ŋmeii bibii yɛŋ ni nuɔ tso lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛbaa. Kɛ́ akɛ samla ni gbeɔ kooloi loo gbɔmɔtsoŋ gbɛtsii nii ko tsu ŋmeii yɛji ahe nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni hela lɛ akagbɛ ashwã ni eha tso lɛ akagbɔjɔ.

english: Animal manure improves soil structure so it holds water better during dry spells. As it decays, it slowly releases nutrients that nourish plant roots, making crops stronger and more resistant to poor weather.
ga: Koolooi ashishifãi haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii feɔ fɛo koni nu lɛ ahi shi jogbaŋŋ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli. Beni efiteɔ lɛ, ejieɔ niyenii ni haa tsei shishifãi lɛ hewalɛ fiofio. Ehaa tsei lɛ feɔ hewalɛ ni amɛnyɛɔ amɛshiɔ kɔɔyɔŋ tsakemɔi ni ehiii lɛ.

english: Why do weeds cause my crops to stay short and produce smaller harvests?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi haa miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ feɔ kuku ni amɛwoɔ yibii fioo lɛ?

english: Weeds steal light, space, water, and soil nutrients directly from your crops. Clearing weeds early ensures your crops get all the food and water they need to grow tall and produce good yields.
ga: Jwɛi juɔ la, ŋwɛi, nu, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ niyenii kɛjɛɔ onibii amli tɛ̃ɛ. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra Eyeɔ ebuaa ni okwɛɔ koni oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aná niyenii kɛ nu ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛwo ŋmɔshi nibii kpakpai.

english: Why do my crops yield less when I plant many seeds close together in one spot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ wooo yibii fioo kɛ́ midu dumɔwui babaoo ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe yɛ he kome lɛ?

english: When seeds are planted too close together, the growing plants compete with each other for sunlight, root space, and ground nutrients. Giving each plant proper spacing allows its roots and stems to spread out and produce maximum yield.
ga: Kɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei ni miida lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, shishifãi ahe gbɛ, kɛ niyenii ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Kɛ́ akɛ gbɛ ni sa ha tso fɛɛ tso teŋ lɛ, ebaaye ebua shishifãi kɛ shishifãi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ni amɛha yibii babaoo aba.

english: Can I put fresh droppings from my chicken farm directly onto my maize plants?
ga: Ani manyɛ mikɛ ŋmei hee ni jɛ mikooloi aŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ awo ŋmei tsei lɛ anɔ tɛ̃ɛ?

english: Fresh poultry droppings are very strong and high in nitrogen, which can heat up and burn plant roots. You should dry or compost the droppings with dry leaves for a few weeks before applying them to give crops steady nutrients without burning them.
ga: Kooloi ashishifã hee lɛ mli eyi obɔ kɛ nitrogen babaoo. ni baanyɛ aha tsei ashishifãi lɛ adɔ ni amɛshã Esa akɛ okɛ ŋmeii ni egboi lɛ agbi loo okɛ ŋmeii ni egboi awo mli otsii fioo komɛi dani okɛtsu nii koni eha tsei lɛ aná niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni yaa nɔ daa ni oshãaa amɛ.

english: Is pig manure good for growing vegetables like tomatoes and garden eggs?
ga: Ani tsina ŋmei hi kɛha aduawai tamɔ tomato kɛ ŋmeii adumɔ yɛ abɔɔ mli?

english: Pig manure is rich in nutrients and helps soil retain water, but it must be fully composted before use to kill parasites and weed seeds so it feeds your crops safely.
ga: Kplotoo ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo yɛ mli ni eyeɔ ebuaa shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ehiɛɔ nu mli. Shi esa akɛ atsɔ mli kwraa dani akɛtsu nii ni akɛgbe tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ jwɛi dumɔwui. Koni okɛye oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ shweshweeshwe

english: Why do my pepper plant leaves fold up and droop under the afternoon sun even when I water them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ shi ni efoɔ yɛ shwane hulu lɛ shishi eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu haa lɛ moŋ?

english: In high heat, plants lose water through their leaves faster than their roots can suck it up from the soil. The leaves wilt temporarily to protect themselves from losing too much moisture, and they usually bounce back once the sun goes down.
ga: Yɛ shihilɛi ni mli edɔ waa mli lɛ Tsei lɛ laajeɔ nu kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Baai lɛ baagboi yɛ be kukuoo mli koni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni fa fe nine lɛ he. ni bei pii lɛ, efoɔ ehe kɛji hulu lɛ nyɔ shi.

english: Why do my tomato plants drop their flowers without producing any fruit during heavy rains?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ fɔɔ fɔfɔi ni amɛwooo yibii yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Heavy rains can wash away pollen or prevent insects like bees from visiting flowers. Without pollination, the plant cannot form fruit, so it sheds the unpollinated flowers.
ga: Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ baanyɛ afɔ fɔfɔi lɛ ahe loo etsĩ kooloi bibii tamɔ ŋmeii anaa koni amɛkasara fɔfɔi lɛ. Kɛji pollination bɛ lɛ Tso lɛ nyɛŋ awo yibii. No hewɔ lɛ, fɔfɔi ni awooo amɛ pollen lɛ shwieɔ shi.

english: Why are my cassava leaves turning yellow and curling up into small shapes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava baai lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe bibii lɛ?

english: Curled and yellow leaves on cassava are typically caused by Cassava Mosaic Disease, which is spread by tiny whitefly insects. Planting disease-resistant cassava varieties helps prevent this.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmei mosaic hela ji nɔ ni kɛ ŋmei baai ni ebɔle ehe ni efee ŋmɔŋ lɛ baa. ni ŋmeii bibii ni ji whiteflies lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa Kasava henɔi ni helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ adumɔ yeɔ ebuaa ni atsĩɔ enɛ naa.

english: Why are my maize plants growing tall and thin like sticks without producing big cobs?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele tsei lɛ daraa ni amɛfeɔ mlɛo tamɔ tsei niji ni toi wuji ekwɛɛɛ amɛ lɛ?

english: When seeds are planted too close together, plants fight each other for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients. This causes them to spend all their energy growing tall to reach light instead of building strong stems and large cobs.
ga: Kɛ adu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, nu, kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Enɛ haa amɛkɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii koni amɛdara koni amɛshɛ la lɛ he. Mohu ɔ, e peeɔ tso nɛ mi wa kɛ tso nguanguahi.

english: Why do my yam tubers turn out small and misshapen at harvest time?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potato tsei lɛ bibii ni efite yɛ kpamɔ be mli lɛ?

english: Yams need soft, loose, and deep soil mounds to expand easily. If the soil is hard, stony, or compacted, the roots struggle to expand, resulting in small or bent tubers.
ga: Sweet potatoes he miihia shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ, ni yɔɔ mlɛo, ni mli kwɔ koni egbɛ eshwa mlɛo. Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ wa, tɛi yɔɔ mli, loo eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ, ebaawa akɛ shishifãi lɛ baagbɛ amɛshwã. Enɛ haa yitso lɛ feɔ bibioo loo ebɔleɔ ehe.

english: Why do extension officers advise planting cowpeas or peanuts alongside maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ extension nitsulɔi lɛ woɔ ŋaa akɛ akɛ ŋmãa adu tsina ŋmãa loo ŋmãa lɛ?

english: Legumes like cowpeas and peanuts take nitrogen gas from the air and store it in the soil, providing free natural food for the maize while ground cover reduces weed growth.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas kɛ peanuts lɛ jieɔ nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Bɔni afee ni ŋmãa lɛ aná adebɔɔ mli niyenii ni aheee nɔ ko. yɛ be mli ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛhaa nɔ lɛ haa jwɛi lɛ shweremɔ baa shi.

english: Why do young cocoa trees burn and die if I don't plant plantains around them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kookoo tsei bibii lɛ shãa ni amɛgboiɔ kɛji miduuu plantains yɛ amɛhe lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants are very sensitive to direct, intense heat from the sun. Fast-growing plantain trees act like umbrellas, providing shade and keeping the soil moist while the cocoa establishes itself.
ga: Kookoo tsei bibii lɛ nuɔ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ he waa. Dumɔwui ni daraa oya lɛ tsuɔ nii tamɔ ambrela. Ha hulutsoo ni oha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ be mli ni kookoo lɛ shwereɔ lɛ.

english: Why does planting cover crops like sweet potato vines stop weeds from overtaking my main farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛhaa nɔ tamɔ sweet potato wain tsei ni aduɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni jwɛi akaye miŋmɔ wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Cover crops spread rapidly across the ground, blocking sunlight from reaching weed seeds in the dirt so they cannot sprout, while also protecting topsoil from heavy rain erosion.
ga: Tsei ni haa shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oya. Tsi hulu la naa koni ekashɛ jwɛi dumɔwui ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ ahe koni amɛkakwɛ̃. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebuɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ he koni nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ akafite.

english: How does growing my vegetables inside a greenhouse help them grow better than in the open field?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ aduawai ni aduɔ yɛ ŋmɔ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa amɛ ni amɛdaraa jogbaŋŋ fe ŋmɔ mli?

english: A greenhouse protects your crops from severe heat, heavy rains, and destructive insects. It creates a controlled environment where plants receive steady moisture and warmth, allowing them to grow faster and produce food all year round.
ga: Greenhouses buɔ onibii ahe kɛjɛɔ dɔlɛ ni naa wa, nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa, kɛ kooloi ni fiteɔ nii lɛ ahe. Bɔɔ shihilɛ ko ni akudɔ He ni tsei lɛ naa ŋmɔtɔ kɛ hulutsoo be fɛɛ be. Eyeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛdaraa oya ni amɛwoɔ niyenii afi muu lɛ fɛɛ.

english: Why do my tomato flowers fall off without turning into fruit when the dry season heat gets too strong?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni etsɔɔɔ aduawai beni hulutsoo be lɛ mli latsaa lɛ mli wa tsɔ lɛ?

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when exposed to extreme heat or irregular watering to protect themselves from dying. Without steady water to cool the plant, it loses the energy needed to turn flowers into tomatoes.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛyashɛ hulutsoo be ni naa wa loo nu ni akɛhaa amɛ be fɛɛ be mli koni amɛkɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ gbele he. Kɛji nu ni yaa nɔ daa ni baaha tso lɛ mli ajɔ lɛ bɛ lɛ Tso lɛ baafite hewalɛ ni he hiaa koni ekɛtsake fɔfɔi lɛ ewo tomato mli.

english: Why should I avoid planting maize on the exact same spot on my farm year after year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ matsi mihe kɛjɛ ŋmãa dumɔ he yɛ he kome yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli daa afi lɛ?

english: Maize feeds heavily on soil nutrients like nitrogen. Planting it continuously in the same spot drains the soil completely and allows maize-specific pests and diseases to build up in the dirt, making future harvests much weaker.
ga: Abɛi yeɔ niyenii babaoo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, tamɔ nitrogen. Kɛ́ aya nɔ adu nii yɛ he kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nu atsɔ mli kwraa. ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ helai ni baa ŋmãa nɔ lɛ buaa amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nɔ ni jɛ mli ba ji akɛ, wɔsɛɛ be mli ŋmaakpamɔi lɛ baafee nɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ kwraa.

english: Why is it bad for me to apply fertilizer to my crops right before a heavy rain begins?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehiii akɛ mawo ŋmɔshi nibii amli ŋmɔshi nii dani nugbɔ anɛ waa lɛ?

english: Heavy rains wash the fertilizer away from your field before the plant roots have a chance to drink it up. This wastes your money and leaves the plants without the nutrients they need.
ga: Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ hoɔ ŋmɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii dani tsei shishifãi lɛ náa hegbɛ amɛnuɔ. Nakai feemɔ baaha ofite shika, ni ebaaha tso lɛ anine ashɛ niyenii ni he hiaa lɛ lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do my maize stalks grow tall, thin, and yield small cobs when I plant the seeds too close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele tsei lɛ kɛlɛ, amɛhe ejɔ, ni amɛwoɔ ŋmeii bibii lɛ? Beni adu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ

english: When planted too close, maize plants compete aggressively with each other for light, water, and soil nutrients. Instead of putting energy into producing big cobs, they stretch upward to reach sunlight, resulting in weak stalks.
ga: Kɛ adu Abele tsei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ akaŋshii mli waa koni amɛná la, nu, kɛ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni amɛkɛ hewalɛ baatsu nii ni amɛkɛfee ŋmeii wuji Amɛkpãa amɛhe koni amɛmɔ hulu la lɛ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji tsei ni bɛ hewalɛ

english: Tying tomato plants off the ground keeps the leaves and fruits from touching wet soil, which prevents rot and fungal diseases while allowing good airflow and sun exposure for even ripening.
ga: Tomato tsei ni akɛfiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ haaa baai kɛ aduawai lɛ akashɛ shikpɔŋ ni efɔ lɛ he. Enɛ baaye abua ni akafite kɛ ŋmeii. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ehaa kɔɔyɔɔ kpakpa tsɔɔ mli ni hulu la lɛ hu shwereɔ.

english: Why are the leaves of my pepper plants turning yellow and curling up at the edges?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper baai lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe lɛ?

english: Leaf curling and yellowing usually happen when tiny sap-sucking insects like aphids or whiteflies attack the underside of the leaves, or when the plant is infected by a virus carried by these insects.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ baa kɛji kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ aphids loo whiteflies lɛ tutua baai lɛ ashishigbɛ. Aloo kɛ́ hela ko ni nɛkɛ kooloi bibii nɛɛ hiɛɔ lɛ emɔ tsei.

english: Why are my cabbage leaves suddenly full of small holes after a light rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cabbage baai lɛ eyi kɛ bu bibii lɛ? Yɛ nugbɔ fioo ko sɛɛ?

english: Small holes in cabbage leaves are typically caused by caterpillars or flea beetles that hatch and feed aggressively when humidity rises after rain. They chew the leaves, reducing the plant's ability to form a solid cabbage head.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii loo ŋmeii ni fɔ̃ɔ ni amɛyeɔ nii waa kɛji nugbɔshiimɔ sɛɛ hulutsoo be lɛ tee hiɛ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ buji bibii ni yɔɔ kaabe baai amli lɛ baa. Amɛyeɔ baai lɛ, ni no fiteɔ nyɛmɔ ni tso lɛ yɔɔ ni ekɛfeɔ kaabe yitsei ni wa lɛ.

english: Why does weed growth slow down the early growth of my young cassava plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi ni kwɛ̃ɔ lɛ haa mi yucca tsei bibii lɛ adalɛ baa shi yɛ shishijee mli lɛ?

english: Young cassava plants have small roots and few leaves, making them too weak to compete with fast-growing weeds for water, fertilizer, and sunlight. Clearing weeds early allows the cassava to establish strong roots.
ga: Cassava tsei bibii lɛ yɛ shishifãi bibii kɛ baai fioo pɛ. Enɛ haa amɛgbɔjɔɔ tsɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛkɛ jwɛi ni kwɛ̃ɔ oya lɛ abɔ akaŋ kɛha nu, ŋmɔshi nibii, kɛ hulu la. Enɛ baaha ŋmei lɛ aná shishifãi ni wa.

english: Why are my bean seeds rotting under the soil instead of sprouting after I water the bed heavily?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-beans lɛ miifite yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeekwɛ̃ beni mikɛ nu ewo saatso lɛ nɔ waa sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Seeds need both air and moisture to germinate. Over-watering fills up all the tiny air spaces in the soil, suffocating the seed and encouraging fungal mold to rot it before it can sprout.
ga: Dumɔwui he hia kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ fɛ̃i fɛɛ dani amɛkwɛ̃. Nu ni akɛwoɔ mli fe nine lɛ haa kɔɔyɔɔ kotokui bibii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ eyiɔ obɔ, ni ehaa dumɔwui lɛ shwieɔ shi ni ewoɔ ŋmeii lɛ hewalɛ koni amɛgboi dani amɛkwɛ̃.

english: Why are grasscutters always targeting and eating my tender cassava stems at night instead of the wild grass surrounding my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mɛi ni shwieɔ jwɛi lɛ kwɛɔ mi-cassava tsei lɛ anɔ ni amɛyeɔ amɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ? Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni maye koo mli jwɛi ni bɔle miŋmɔ lɛ he lɛ

english: Cassava stems and tubers are rich in starches, moisture, and essential nutrients compared to dry wild grass. Grasscutters naturally seek out high-energy, juicy crops to satisfy their hunger and hydration needs, especially during dry spells.
ga: Cassava tsei kɛ shishifãi lɛ amli eyi obɔ kɛ starch, ŋmɔtɔ kɛ niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛ akɛto koo mli jwɛi ni egbi lɛ ahe. Mɛi ni shwieɔ jwɛi lɛ taoɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni mli ewo muji ni haa hewalɛ babaoo be fɛɛ be koni amɛkɛtsu amɛ hɔmɔ kɛ nu he hiamɔ nii ahe nii. Titri lɛ, yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli

english: How do I know if my maize leaves curling up during the hot afternoon means the plants are dying or just resting?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji akɛ ŋmãa baai ni shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane ni mli edɔ lɛ mli lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ miigbo loo ehiɛ edɔ kɛkɛ?

english: Leaf curling in maize is a natural defense mechanism to reduce water loss under intense heat. It does not mean the plant is dead, but if the leaves stay tightly rolled early in the morning before the sun comes up, it indicates severe moisture stress requiring urgent watering.
ga: Baai ni shwieɔ shi yɛ ŋmãa mli lɛ ji adebɔɔ mli hebuu gbɛ ni haa nu ni laajeɔ yɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa shishi lɛ baa shi. Enɛ etsɔɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ egbo. Shi kɛji akɛ baai lɛ ebɔle amɛhe lolo leebi dani hulu lɛ te shi lɛ Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni naa wa ni biɔ ni awo amɛ nu oya.

english: Why do my yellowing pepper plants perk up quickly when I put poultry manure, but dry fertilizer seems to burn them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-yellow pepper tso lɛ daa oya kɛji mikɛ kooloi afɔfɔi fata he lɛ? Shi etamɔ nɔ ni ŋmeii ni egbi lɛ shãa amɛ?

english: Poultry manure releases nutrients slowly and improves the soil's ability to hold moisture safely around the roots. Chemical fertilizers are concentrated salts that need plenty of water to dissolve, and applying them to dry soil pulls water away from plant roots, causing root burn.
ga: Kooloi ashishifã jieɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ nii fiofio. ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛɔ ehiɛɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni bɔleɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ mli shweshweeshwe Tsofai ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔtɔ mli lɛ ji ŋmɔtɔi ni mli eyi obɔ kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni biɔ nu babaoo dani etsɔ mli. Ni kɛ akɛ tsofai ni akɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaagbala nu kɛjɛ tsei lɛ ashishifãi amli. Ebaanyɛ eha shishifãi ashã.

english: Why do my tomato plants shed their flowers without producing any fruit when the weather becomes extremely hot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni amɛwooo yibii be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ waa lɛ?

english: Excessive heat causes tomato pollen to dry up and become sterile, preventing successful fertilization. To protect itself from wasting energy on unviable fruit, the plant naturally drops its unpollinated flowers until cooler weather returns.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni fa fe nine lɛ haa tomato mli ŋmeii lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni ehaa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe. Enɛ haaa fɔmɔ aba. Koni obu ohe kɛjɛ hewalɛ ni okɛbaafite yɛ aduawai ni nyɛŋ aha wala ahi shi lɛ he. Tsei lɛ baajie fɔfɔi ni shwieee amɛhe lɛ kpo yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe kɛyashi be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli baajɔ ekoŋŋ.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings turn yellow and dry out when I clear all the tall shade trees around them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo tsei bibii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbiɔ beni mijieɔ tsei kakadaji ni yɔɔ hulutsoo ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants are sensitive to direct sunlight and high wind. Canopy trees act as protective umbrellas that shade tender leaves from harsh heat and keep the topsoil moist so the seedlings can establish strong roots.
ga: Kookoo tsei bibii lɛ nuɔ hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa he waa. Tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ tsuɔ nii akɛ ŋtayaa ni buɔ mɔ he, ni ebuɔ baai bibii ahe kɛjɛɔ latsaa ni naa wa lɛ he. ni oha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fã lɛ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ bɔni afee ni dumɔwui lɛ anyɛ aná shishifãi ni wa.

english: Why does spear grass keep growing back on my farm even after I clear the land and spray chemical weedkiller?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ spear jwɛi yaa nɔ ekwɛ̃ɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ? Beni mijie jɛmɛ ni mikɛ tsofai ni gbeɔ jwɛi lɛ shwie shi lɛ sɛɛ po.

english: Spear grass has deep underground stems called rhizomes that store food reserves. Even when the top leaves dry up or are cut, these hidden underground roots remain alive and quickly shoot up fresh leaves after the next rain.
ga: Spear jwɛi lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii ni mli kwɔ ni atsɛɔ amɛ rhizomes ni akɛtoɔ niyenii ni ato he gbɛjianɔ lɛ. Kɛji akɛ ŋwɛi baai lɛ egbi loo afolɔ amɛ po. Nɛkɛ shishifãi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi ni yɔɔ teemɔŋ nɛɛ hiɔ shi ni amɛwoɔ baai heei oya yɛ nugbɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ sɛɛ.

english: Why do fall armyworms prefer attacking young, sweet maize plants instead of the older maize with hard stalks?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fall armyworms lɛ sumɔɔ ni amɛtutua ŋmãa tsei bibii ni ŋɔɔ lɛ moŋ fe ŋmãa ni eda ni amɛhe wa lɛ?

english: Young maize plants have soft, succulent leaf whorls that allow caterpillars to easily chew, hide, and feed. Older plants develop tough leaf tissues and high silica content that make them difficult for young insects to eat and digest.
ga: Abɛi bibii tsei lɛ yɛ baai ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ ni mli ewo nu ni haa efeɔ mlɛo kɛhaa ŋmeii lɛ akɛ amɛbaaye, amɛtee amɛhe ni amɛye niyenii. Tsei ni edara lɛ yɛ baai ahe fãji ni mli wa, ni silica fa yɛ mli. Enɛ haa ewaa kɛhaa kooloi bibii akɛ amɛaaye nii ni amɛye nii.

english: Why do my plantain suckers produce very small bunches when I plant many of them close together in one spot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi dumɔwui lɛ woɔ ŋmeii bibii waa kɛ́ midu tsei babaoo ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe yɛ he kome lɛ?

english: Plantains require large amounts of sunlight, soil moisture, and nutrients to build big stems and heavy bunches. When planted too close, their roots and broad leaves fight each other for resources, leaving insufficient energy for fruit production.
ga: Hulu la he miihia plantains. shikpɔŋ mli nu ni mli edɔ kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ babaoo koni ekɛfee tsei agboi kɛ jwɛi ni tsii Kɛji adu amɛ bɛŋkɛ tsɔ Shishifãi ni mli kwɔlɔ kɛ baai lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ nibii ni he hiaa lɛ amli. Enɛ haa hewalɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa kɛha aduawai afeemɔ baaa.

english: Why do white powdery spots appear on my garden egg leaves after heavy rain followed by hot sunshine?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ powder yɛŋ ni tamɔ powder jeɔ kpo yɛ eggplant baai ni yɔɔ mibɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ anɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa ni hulu ni tsoɔ waa nyiɛɔ sɛɛ lɛ sɛɛ?

english: The white coating is powdery mildew, a fungal disease that thrives when high humidity from rain mixes with warm air. The fungus spreads through microscopic spores in humid conditions, covering leaves and blocking the sunlight needed for crop growth.
ga: Nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ yɛŋ lɛ ji powder mildew. Eji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni baa kɛji nugbɔ ni nɛɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ lɛ futu mli lɛ mli fɛ̃i babaoo yɛ. Fungi lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa kɛtsɔɔ ŋmeii bibii waa amli yɛ shihilɛi ni mli edɔ waa amli. Ehaa baai lɛ ahe ni etsĩɔ hulu la ni he hiaa kɛha tsei lɛ adalɛ naa.

english: Why do my yam tubers grow long and thin instead of getting big and round when the soil is very hard?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi sweet potato tubers lɛ kɛlɛ ni eyɛ mlɛo moŋ fe ni eeefee agbo ni eyɛ kokroo be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli wa waa lɛ?

english: Yam tubers expand easily in loose, mounded, or deep soil. When soil is compacted and hard, the tuber faces physical resistance and is forced to push downward where it is easiest, resulting in thin, long tubers instead of thick ones.
ga: Sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ mli lɛɛɔ oya yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ edɔ, gɔji, loo shikpɔŋ ni mli kwɔ nɔ kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli edɔ ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Yitso lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ shitee-kɛ-woo baakpe. ni anyɛ enɔ ni ekɛshwie shi yɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni kɛlɛ lɛ baa yɛ ŋmeii ni mli tse lɛ najiaŋ.

english: Why are the leaves on my young cocoa seedlings turning brown and curling up in the sun?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ ahe baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni amɛkpãa amɛhe yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: Young cocoa seedlings cannot handle direct sunlight because their root systems are not strong enough to absorb enough water. Planting shade crops like plantains around them protects them from harsh heat and keeps the soil moist.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ nyɛŋ aŋmɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ gbɛ ejaakɛ amɛshishifãi lɛ bɛ hewalɛ bɔ ni sa ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛŋɔ nu ni fa bɔ ni sa. Kɛ́ adu tsei ni yɔɔ hulutsoo be mli tamɔ plantains yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu tsei lɛ ahe kɛjɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa he, ni ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: This is caused by a fungal condition called Black Pod disease, which spreads rapidly in damp, overly shaded areas. Clearing weeds and pruning excess tree branches improves airflow and sunlight, which helps prevent the fungus from spreading.
ga: Fungal hela ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ black pod hela kɛ enɛ baa. Egbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni hulutsoo be yɔɔ ni hulutsoo be yɔɔ fe nine lɛ. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ kɛ tsei niji ni fa fe nine lɛ afolɔ haa kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ kɛ hulu la yaa hiɛ. Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmɔtɔ akagbɛ eshwa.

english: Why does the extension officer tell me to cut off some of the healthy-looking branches on my cocoa tree?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ extension nitsulɔi lɛ kɛɔ mi akɛ mafolɔ kookoo niji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ ekomɛi lɛ?

english: Pruning removes non-productive or overcrowded branches so the tree does not waste energy on extra leaves. Instead, it directs water and nutrients straight into growing bigger, healthier cocoa pods.
ga: Niji ni afoɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ejieɔ tsei niji ni wooo yibii loo ni ebɔle amɛhe fe nine lɛ. Bɔni afee ni tso lɛ akafite hewalɛ yɛ baai ni fa fe nine lɛ anɔ. Mohu ɔ, a ngɔɔ nu kɛ níhi nɛ haa nɔ he wami ɔ kɛ yaa kookoo tso nɛ a he wa nɛ a ngɛ he wami ɔ mi tɛ̃ɛ.

english: Planting the same crop continuously depletes specific nutrients from the soil and allows crop-specific pests to build up in the ground. Rotating with legumes like cowpeas restores nitrogen to the soil naturally.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ baaha niyenii pɔtɛɛ komɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ afite be fɛɛ be. ni ehaa tsofai pɔtɛɛ komɛi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ buaa amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ akɛ ŋmeii tamɔ tsina ŋmeii tsakeɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ekɛ nitrogen baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa.

english: How do I know if my farm soil is lacking nutrients before I start planting?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ bɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ dani mabɔi dumɔwui?

english: Signs of poor soil health include stunted plant growth, pale or yellowing leaves, and poor yield from previous harvests. Testing the soil or observing weak weed growth can also indicate low nutrient levels.
ga: Nɔ ni fata okadii ni tsɔɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ bɛ hewalɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ ahe ji tsei ni edaaa jogbaŋŋ. Baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ loo ŋmɔŋ kɛ yibiiwoo ni ehiii kɛjɛ ŋmaakpamɔi ni eho lɛ amli Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kaa loo jwɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ ni kwɛ̃ɔ lɛ baanyɛ atsɔɔ akɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ faaa.

english: When plants are overcrowded, their roots fight over the same soil nutrients and water, while their leaves block sunlight from reaching each other. Proper spacing ensures each plant grows strong and produces a full harvest.
ga: Beni tsei lɛ ebɔle amɛhe tsɔ lɛ Amɛshishifãi lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ nu mli. yɛ be mli ni amɛbaai lɛ tsiɔ hulu la lɛ naa koni ekashɛ amɛhe. Gbɛ ni sa ni ato lɛ haa tso fɛɛ tso daa waa ni ewoɔ ŋmaa ni fa babaoo.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot underground when we get heavy rainfall?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii shishifãi fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots rot when water collects in the soil and cannot drain away, starving the roots of air. Planting on raised soil mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain off and protects the roots.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu bua ehe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni enyɛɛɛ ejɛ mli. Enɛ haa kɔɔyɔɔ bɛ shishifãi lɛ amli. Kɛ́ adu yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ, ebaaha nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ atsɔ mli ni ebu shishifãi lɛ ahe.

english: Why do seeds I saved from my last maize harvest grow weaker than the certified seeds I buy?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni mikɛto kɛjɛ naagbee ŋmãa kpamɔ lɛ mli lɛ bɛ hewalɛ fe dumɔwui ni awo he odase ni mihe lɛ?

english: Commercial certified seeds are specifically bred for high performance, pest resistance, and yield. Seeds saved from hybrid harvests lose these special traits in the next generation, producing weaker crops.
ga: Akwɛɔ dumɔwui ni akɛ jarayeli he odaseyeli haa lɛ pɔtɛɛ koni amɛtsu nii jogbaŋŋ. Pest ni nyɛɔ eshiɔ kɛ yibiiwoo. Dumɔwui ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛkpaa nii lɛ amli lɛ baafite sui nɛɛ yɛ yinɔ ni baa lɛ mli. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ baa shi.
